description: An evidence-backed path between two DFX ids across every graph: each hop is a published relationship with its source, or an identity link by shared CRD, CIK or EIN. NO_MATCH means no observed path within the hop budget, not that the two are unconnected. Without a paid plan on a vertical, lists name their first 5 rows and count the rest; each answer states what it withheld.
